statements.agree: Labour should have priority over capital.
statements.disagree: Labour should not have priority over capital.
statements.note: About whether human work should come before capital, meaning the assets and funds used in production. Supporting some workers' rights is not enough.

statements.text: Trial by jury should be guaranteed by the constitution.
statements.agree: Trial by jury should be guaranteed by the constitution.
statements.disagree: Trial by jury should not be guaranteed by the constitution.
statements.note: About a constitutional right to have ordinary citizens decide the facts in trials. It does not require juries for every kind of legal proceeding.

statements.text: The constitution should provide a regular opportunity for each generation to revise it.
statements.agree: The constitution should provide a regular opportunity for each generation to revise it.
statements.disagree: The constitution need not provide a regular opportunity for each generation to revise it.
statements.note: About a scheduled opportunity to reconsider the constitution roughly once a generation, not a requirement to replace it every time.

statements.text: A federation's member states should have the right to block national laws they judge to exceed the national government's constitutional powers.
statements.agree: A federation's member states should have the right to block national laws they judge to exceed the national government's constitutional powers.
statements.disagree: A federation's member states should not have the right to block national laws they judge to exceed the national government's constitutional powers.
statements.note: About each member state deciding for itself that a national law exceeds the national government's powers and preventing its enforcement within that state. Taking the dispute to a national court is a different question.

statements.text: There should be an upper limit on personal income.
statements.agree: There should be an upper limit on personal income.
statements.disagree: There should not be an upper limit on personal income.
statements.note: About a maximum income, distinct from taxing high incomes at a rate below complete confiscation.

statements.text: A full-time working week should be no more than four days.
statements.agree: A full-time working week should be no more than four days.
statements.disagree: A full-time working week should be more than four days.
statements.note: About the length of a full-time working week: four days or fewer. Shorter hours for only some workers is not enough.

statements.text: Humans are entitled to use animals for their own purposes.
statements.agree: Humans are entitled to use animals for their own purposes.
statements.disagree: Humans are not entitled to use animals for their own purposes.
statements.note: About whether animals may be treated as resources at all (for food, work, research or sport), whatever care is taken over their suffering.

statements.text: A country should bring its troops home from bases abroad.
statements.agree: A country should bring its troops home from bases abroad.
statements.disagree: A country should keep troops stationed abroad.
statements.note: About stationing troops in other countries, independently of alliance commitments.

statements.text: Freedom is the learned ability to govern one’s own desires.
statements.agree: Freedom is the learned ability to govern one’s own desires.
statements.disagree: Freedom is not the learned ability to govern one’s own desires.
statements.note: About what freedom is: a learned self-mastery over one's own desires. Being free from outside interference is a different question.

statements.text: In every democracy, real power inevitably ends up with a small group of leaders.
statements.agree: In every democracy, real power inevitably ends up with a small group of leaders.
statements.disagree: A democracy can keep real power out of the hands of a small group of leaders.
statements.note: About whether real power inevitably ends up with a small group of leaders, even in democracies and democratic organisations such as parties and unions. Some leaders having more influence is not enough.

statements.text: Each racial community should control its own economy.
statements.agree: Each racial community should control its own economy.
statements.disagree: Racial communities should not each control their own economy.
statements.note: About each racial community controlling its own economy, including a minority community within a larger country. Equal access to a shared economy is a different question.

statements.text: Governments should compensate the descendants of enslaved people.
statements.agree: Governments should compensate the descendants of enslaved people.
statements.disagree: Governments should not compensate the descendants of enslaved people.
statements.note: About compensation owed for ancestral slavery, without prescribing an individual cash payment or a particular territorial settlement.

statements.text: A region’s natural resources should belong to the people of that region.
statements.agree: A region’s natural resources should belong to the people of that region.
statements.disagree: A region’s natural resources should not belong to the people of that region.
statements.note: About a region's natural resources, such as oil, water or minerals, belonging to the people who live there rather than to the whole country. Sharing some of the revenue with the region is not enough.

statements.text: Socialism cannot be reached without revolutionary war.
statements.agree: Socialism cannot be reached without revolutionary war.
statements.disagree: Socialism can be reached without revolutionary war.
statements.note: About whether armed revolution is the only road to socialism, in rich countries as well as poor ones. Thinking some revolution was justified is not enough.

statements.text: A revolutionary party should be organised on military lines.
statements.agree: A revolutionary party should be organised on military lines.
statements.disagree: A revolutionary party should not be organised on military lines.
statements.note: About the party’s own military organisation, distinct from party control of an army.

statements.text: A country's wealth comes only from its land.
statements.agree: A country's wealth comes only from its land.
statements.disagree: A country's wealth does not come only from its land.
statements.note: About whether a country's wealth comes only from what its land yields, through farming, mining and fishing, while manufacturing and trade only reshape or move it. Land being an important source of wealth is not enough.

statements.text: A communist revolution needs no transitional stage before communism.
statements.agree: A communist revolution needs no transitional stage before communism.
statements.disagree: A communist revolution needs a transitional stage before communism.
statements.note: About whether a revolution can create communism straight away, without first passing through a transitional stage such as socialism. Wanting a short transition is a different question.

statements.text: Members of other ethnic groups should be removed from the country.
statements.agree: Members of other ethnic groups should be removed from the country.
statements.disagree: Members of other ethnic groups should be free to stay in the country.
statements.note: About forcing people of other ethnic groups out of the country, or out of the part of a larger state claimed for one's own group (as in Greater Serbia and Greater Croatia). Unlike the minority-transfer statement, it needs no claim that they are hostile.

statements.text: Everyone able to work should do some physical labour.
statements.agree: Everyone able to work should do some physical labour.
statements.disagree: Not everyone able to work has a duty to do physical labour.
statements.note: About whether everyone able to work has a duty to do some physical labour, even people with desk or intellectual jobs. Respecting manual work is not enough.

statements.text: People who disobey unjust laws should accept the legal penalties.
statements.agree: People who disobey unjust laws should accept the legal penalties.
statements.disagree: People who disobey unjust laws need not accept the legal penalties.
statements.note: About whether someone who breaks an unjust law should accept the punishment rather than avoid it. Believing the law is unjust is a different question.

statements.text: Workers and farmers should form a political alliance.
statements.agree: Workers and farmers should form a political alliance.
statements.disagree: Workers and farmers should not form a political alliance.
statements.note: About workers and farmers forming a lasting political alliance. Cooperating on a single issue is not enough.

statements.text: A healthy democracy needs a clash of opposing political positions.
statements.agree: A healthy democracy needs a clash of opposing political positions.
statements.disagree: A healthy democracy does not need a clash of opposing political positions.
statements.note: About whether a healthy democracy needs real opposition between political positions, such as rival parties or platforms. Being polite or willing to compromise is a different question.

statements.text: Political borders should follow the boundaries of natural ecosystems.
statements.agree: Political borders should follow the boundaries of natural ecosystems.
statements.disagree: Political borders should not follow the boundaries of natural ecosystems.
statements.note: About drawing the units of government around watersheds and other natural regions instead of historical or administrative lines. Cooperating across borders to protect a river or forest is not enough.

statements.text: Transgender women should be excluded from women-only spaces.
statements.agree: Transgender women should be excluded from women-only spaces.
statements.disagree: Transgender women should not be excluded from women-only spaces.
statements.note: About whether transgender women should be barred from spaces reserved for women, such as shelters or changing rooms. Legal gender recognition is a different question.

statements.text: Medical gender transition should be prohibited for children.
statements.agree: Medical gender transition should be prohibited for children.
statements.disagree: Medical gender transition should not be prohibited for children.
statements.note: About a legal ban on medical gender transition for people under eighteen. Wanting more caution or parental consent is not enough.

statements.text: Workers should form political alliances with business owners who oppose foreign domination.
statements.agree: Workers should form political alliances with business owners who oppose foreign domination.
statements.disagree: Workers should not form political alliances with business owners who oppose foreign domination.
statements.note: About workers allying politically with business owners who oppose foreign domination of their country. Backing the same cause once is not enough.

statements.text: Socialism in colonised countries requires a separate democratic stage first.
statements.agree: Socialism in colonised countries requires a separate democratic stage first.
statements.disagree: Socialism in colonised countries does not require a separate democratic stage first.
statements.note: About whether colonised countries must first pass through a separate democratic stage before working towards socialism. Supporting democracy alongside socialism is a different question.

statements.text: The state should finance worker-owned businesses.
statements.agree: The state should finance worker-owned businesses.
statements.disagree: The state should not finance worker-owned businesses.
statements.note: About the state providing money, such as loans or grants, for businesses owned by their workers. Merely allowing worker-owned firms to exist is not enough.

statements.text: Under capitalism, workers' average pay always falls back to the bare minimum needed to live.
statements.agree: Under capitalism, workers' average pay always falls back to the bare minimum needed to live.
statements.disagree: Under capitalism, workers' average pay can stay well above the bare minimum needed to live.
statements.note: About whether average pay under capitalism always falls back to what workers need to survive, however much it rises for a while. Low pay in some jobs is not enough.

statements.text: Work should be the centre of people's lives.
statements.agree: Work should be the centre of people's lives.
statements.disagree: Work should not be the centre of people's lives.
statements.note: About whether work should be what a life is built around (work as calling, duty or human essence), or one activity among many.

statements.text: Working-class political parties should campaign for reforms within capitalism.
statements.agree: Working-class political parties should campaign for reforms within capitalism.
statements.disagree: Working-class political parties should not campaign for reforms within capitalism.
statements.note: About whether working-class parties should campaign for improvements within the existing system, such as better pay or conditions. Also wanting to replace capitalism doesn't count against it.

statements.text: Women should organise apart from men.
statements.agree: Women should organise apart from men.
statements.disagree: Women should organise together with men.
statements.note: About women building their own groups, projects and institutions, run by and for women, with men not admitted. Having a women's committee inside a mixed group is not enough.

statements.text: Human activity is the main cause of current global warming.
statements.agree: Human activity is the main cause of current global warming.
statements.disagree: Human activity is not the main cause of current global warming.
statements.note: What mainly causes the present warming of the climate; separate from the choice of policy response.

statements.text: Political decisions should be reached by consensus.
statements.agree: Political decisions should be reached by consensus.
statements.disagree: Political decisions need not be reached by consensus.
statements.note: About whether political decisions should be made by consensus, meaning general agreement rather than a majority vote. Seeking broad support before a vote is not the same.

statements.text: Public institutions such as schools and hospitals should be kept small.
statements.agree: Public institutions such as schools and hospitals should be kept small.
statements.disagree: Public institutions such as schools and hospitals do not need to be kept small.
statements.note: About keeping schools, hospitals and offices small enough to run at a human scale rather than merging them into large units. Whether they are publicly funded is a different question.

statements.text: Pay for useful work should be based on the worker’s effort.
statements.agree: Pay for useful work should be based on the worker’s effort.
statements.disagree: Pay for useful work should not be based on the worker’s effort.
statements.note: About whether pay for useful work should depend on the worker's effort. Support for people unable to work is a different question.

statements.text: People should have more say in a decision the more it affects them.
statements.agree: People should have more say in a decision the more it affects them.
statements.disagree: Everyone entitled to take part in a decision should have an equal say, however much it affects them.
statements.note: About giving people more say in a decision the more it affects them, in workplaces, communities and government alike, instead of one equal vote each. Wanting everyone to have some say is not enough.

statements.text: Elected officials should refuse to take part in a government they consider illegitimate.
statements.agree: Elected officials should refuse to take part in a government they consider illegitimate.
statements.disagree: Elected officials should take part in a government even if they consider it illegitimate.
statements.note: About winning an election and then refusing to take a seat in a government or parliament one considers illegitimate, since sitting in it would accept its authority. Boycotting the election itself is a different question.

statements.text: Local residents should have the power to block new housing.
statements.agree: Local residents should have the power to block new housing.
statements.disagree: Local residents should not have the power to block new housing.
statements.note: About a local veto over housing construction, separately from consultation.

statements.text: Young people should have the same civil rights as adults.
statements.agree: Young people should have the same civil rights as adults.
statements.disagree: Young people should not have the same civil rights as adults.
statements.note: About whether young age is a reason to give people fewer civil rights, such as free speech or assembly, than adults have. A different age for one right, such as voting, is not the same.

statements.text: Sixteen-year-olds should have the right to vote.
statements.agree: Sixteen-year-olds should have the right to vote.
statements.disagree: Sixteen-year-olds should not have the right to vote.
statements.note: About whether sixteen-year-olds should be allowed to vote. Giving them other rights, such as working or marrying, is a different question.

statements.text: Students should have the right to decide what they learn.
statements.agree: Students should have the right to decide what they learn.
statements.disagree: Students should not have the right to decide what they learn.
statements.note: About students themselves, rather than teachers or the state, having the right to decide what they study. Being consulted about the curriculum is not enough.

statements.text: A country's constitution should recognise its Indigenous peoples as nations.
statements.agree: A country's constitution should recognise its Indigenous peoples as nations.
statements.disagree: A country's constitution should recognise only one nation.
statements.note: About a constitution naming a country's Indigenous peoples, such as the Aymara and Quechua, as nations within one shared state. Recognising their culture or rights without calling them nations is not enough.

statements.text: Indigenous communities should settle internal disputes under their own laws.
statements.agree: Indigenous communities should settle internal disputes under their own laws.
statements.disagree: Indigenous communities should not settle internal disputes under their own laws.
statements.note: About Indigenous communities applying their own laws and customs to disputes among their own members. Disputes with outsiders are a different question.

statements.text: Income tax should be abolished.
statements.agree: Income tax should be abolished.
statements.disagree: Income tax should be kept.
statements.note: About ending taxes on income altogether, funding the state from other taxes such as duties on goods or land. Merely lowering income tax is not enough.

statements.text: Automation will leave most people without work.
statements.agree: Automation will leave most people without work.
statements.disagree: Automation will create new jobs to replace the ones it ends.
statements.note: A forecast about whether machines and AI will put most people out of work for good, or create new kinds of jobs as earlier technology did. Some jobs being lost is not enough.

statements.text: Local governments should run businesses alongside private firms.
statements.agree: Local governments should run businesses alongside private firms.
statements.disagree: Local governments should not run businesses alongside private firms.
statements.note: About city and local governments owning and running businesses, such as bus lines or utilities, alongside private firms. Regulating private firms is not the same.

statements.text: Holding cash should be taxed, even when prices stay stable.
statements.agree: Holding cash should be taxed, even when prices stay stable.
statements.disagree: Holding cash should be free of tax.
statements.note: About a charge on holding cash, such as banknotes losing value unless the holder pays to keep them, so that hoarding costs money. Money deposited in a bank is not charged, and this is not a tax on wealth in general.

statements.text: Price controls are a good way to fight inflation.
statements.agree: Legal limits on how far prices, including pay, may rise are a good way to fight inflation.
statements.disagree: Price controls do more harm than good against inflation.
statements.note: About limiting how fast prices and pay may rise by law, as in 1970s incomes policies, as a way to fight inflation. Controlling the money supply is a different question.

statements.text: Dressing and acting in a feminine way is compatible with feminism.
statements.agree: Dressing and acting in a feminine way is compatible with feminism.
statements.disagree: Feminine dress and behaviour work against feminism.
statements.note: About whether dressing and acting in a feminine way, such as wearing make-up or dresses by choice, can fit with seeking women's equality. Being pressured to do so is not the same.

statements.text: Women's unpaid domestic work is a form of economic exploitation.
statements.agree: Women's unpaid domestic work is a form of economic exploitation.
statements.disagree: Women's unpaid domestic work is a fair contribution to family life.
statements.note: About whether women's unpaid housework and care counts as economic exploitation, meaning work that benefits others without being paid for. Valuing that work is not enough.

statements.text: The people living now should decide which traditions to keep.
statements.agree: The people living now should decide which traditions to keep.
statements.disagree: Inherited traditions should bind the people living now.
statements.note: About whether the people living now have the authority to decide which inherited customs and beliefs to keep or drop. Choosing to keep many traditions doesn't count against it.

statements.text: Governments should nudge people towards choices that are good for them.
statements.agree: Governments should nudge people, through defaults and the way options are presented, towards choices that are good for them, leaving them free to choose otherwise.
statements.disagree: Governments should leave people's choices to them.
statements.note: 'Nudging' (Thaler and Sunstein): steering without bans, e.g. automatic pension enrolment that people can opt out of. Bans and mandates are a separate question.

statements.text: Parliamentary democracy is a viable path to socialism.
statements.agree: Parliamentary democracy is a viable path to socialism.
statements.disagree: Parliamentary democracy is not a viable path to socialism.
statements.note: About whether socialism can be reached through elections and parliament. Winning some reforms in parliament is not enough.

statements.text: People have a duty to resist oppression even at the cost of their own lives.
statements.agree: People have a duty to resist oppression even at the cost of their own lives.
statements.disagree: People may put their own survival before resisting oppression.
statements.note: About whether resistance remains a personal duty when it requires giving up one’s life.

statements.text: A person should be allowed only one spouse at a time.
statements.agree: A person should be allowed only one spouse at a time.
statements.disagree: A person should be allowed more than one spouse at a time.
statements.note: About whether the law should allow only one spouse at a time. Whether people may live with several partners without marrying is a different question.

statements.text: Governments should encourage contact between cultural groups.
statements.agree: Governments should encourage contact between cultural groups.
statements.disagree: Governments should leave cultural groups to keep to themselves if they wish.
statements.note: About governments actively promoting exchange and shared projects between cultural groups. Simply allowing groups to mix is not enough.

statements.text: Exports of advanced technology to rival countries should be restricted.
statements.agree: Exports of advanced technology to rival countries should be restricted.
statements.disagree: Exports of advanced technology to rival countries should not be restricted.
statements.note: About limiting sales of advanced technology to rival countries. Restricting exports to every country is a different question.

statements.text: Governments' laws should apply on the internet.
statements.agree: Governments' laws should apply on the internet.
statements.disagree: The internet should be beyond the reach of governments' laws.
statements.note: About whether governments' ordinary laws should apply to what happens on the internet. Disagreeing with particular online laws is a different question.

statements.text: Even under a repressive government, opposition movements should work only through legal channels.
statements.agree: Even under a repressive government, opposition movements should work only through legal channels.
statements.disagree: Under a repressive government, opposition movements should also organise in secret.
statements.note: About whether opposition movements under a repressive government should give up secret organising and work only through legal groups, papers and unions. Whether their methods are peaceful is a different question.

statements.text: Every country is ready for democracy.
statements.agree: Every country is ready for democracy.
statements.disagree: Some countries need to be ruled without elections until they are ready for democracy.
statements.note: About whether every country is ready for democracy now, or some should be ruled without elections until they are ready. Preferring that democracy arrive gradually is a different question.

statements.text: Fighting racial oppression should take priority over fighting sexism.
statements.agree: Fighting racial oppression should take priority over fighting sexism.
statements.disagree: Fighting racial oppression should not take priority over fighting sexism.
statements.note: About which struggle receives priority, without denying that both forms of oppression exist.

statements.text: Governments should promote liberal democracy abroad.
statements.agree: Governments should promote liberal democracy abroad.
statements.disagree: Governments should not promote liberal democracy abroad.
statements.note: About promoting a political system overseas, without specifying military action.

statements.text: A head of state should have the power to dissolve parliament.
statements.agree: A head of state should have the power to dissolve parliament.
statements.disagree: Only parliament itself should be able to bring its term to an early end.
statements.note: About a king or president having the power to end a parliament and call new elections. A government choosing to call an election itself is a different question.

statements.text: Companies should be required to report their impact on the environment.
statements.agree: Companies should be required to report their impact on the environment.
statements.disagree: Companies should be required to report only their financial results.
statements.note: About a legal requirement for companies to report their effect on the environment, such as their emissions. Voluntary reports are not enough.

statements.text: All land should be owned by the state.
statements.agree: All land should be owned by the state.
statements.disagree: People should be free to own land privately.
statements.note: About ownership of land, distinct from who occupies it or owns buildings.

statements.text: Free trade between countries promotes peace.
statements.agree: Free trade between countries promotes peace.
statements.disagree: Free trade between countries does not promote peace.
statements.note: About whether free trade between countries makes war between them less likely. Whether it makes people richer is a different question.

statements.text: Countries should accept binding international arbitration of their disputes.
statements.agree: Countries should accept binding international arbitration of their disputes.
statements.disagree: Countries should keep the final say over their own disputes.
statements.note: About countries agreeing in advance to accept a binding ruling from an outside arbitrator on disputes diplomacy has not resolved. Voluntary mediation is not enough.

statements.text: Trade unions should run the economy.
statements.agree: Trade unions should run the economy.
statements.disagree: Trade unions should only represent workers, not run the economy.
statements.note: About trade unions taking over production and running the economy, not only bargaining for workers. Strong unions with a say in some decisions is not enough.

statements.text: Wage labour should be abolished.
statements.agree: Wage labour should be abolished.
statements.disagree: Wage labour should not be abolished.
statements.note: About replacing employment for wages, independently of whether money is retained.

statements.text: Sabotage of property is a justified form of political action.
statements.agree: Sabotage of property is a justified form of political action.
statements.disagree: Political action should leave other people's property unharmed.
statements.note: About deliberately damaging machines, buildings or equipment, but not people, as political action. Harming people is a different question.

statements.text: Elected bodies should reserve seats for historically excluded groups.
statements.agree: Elected bodies should reserve seats for historically excluded groups.
statements.disagree: Seats in elected bodies should be open to all candidates on equal terms.
statements.note: About setting aside seats in elected bodies for groups long shut out of power, such as Indigenous peoples or lower castes. Quotas for party candidates are a different question.

statements.text: Evolution has shaped differences in behaviour between women and men.
statements.agree: Evolution has shaped differences in behaviour between women and men.
statements.disagree: Differences in behaviour between women and men have no evolutionary basis.
statements.note: Whether evolution helps explain behavioural differences between the sexes.

statements.text: Basic public services should be free for everyone, whatever their income.
statements.agree: Basic public services should be free for everyone, whatever their income.
statements.disagree: People who can afford to should pay for basic public services.
statements.note: About healthcare, education, transport and similar essentials being free to use for everyone, rich or poor. Free services only for people on low incomes are not enough.

statements.text: Tax havens should be shut down.
statements.agree: Tax havens should be shut down.
statements.disagree: Countries should be free to set low taxes and keep banking secrecy.
statements.note: About ending offshore jurisdictions that attract money with low taxes and secrecy. Tightening some tax-avoidance rules is not enough.

statements.text: Patents on living organisms should be banned.
statements.agree: Patents on living organisms should be banned.
statements.disagree: Living organisms should be patentable like other inventions.
statements.note: About patenting plants, animals, genes and other life forms. Patents on other inventions are a different question.

statements.text: Immigration should favour people who already share the country's culture.
statements.agree: Immigration should favour people who already share the country's culture.
statements.disagree: Immigrants should be admitted regardless of their culture.
statements.note: About selecting immigrants by language and cultural ties, as some points systems do.

statements.text: Citizens should be allowed to hold dual citizenship.
statements.agree: Citizens should be allowed to hold dual citizenship.
statements.disagree: Citizens should not be allowed to hold dual citizenship.
statements.note: About holding the citizenship of two countries at once.

statements.text: Private donations to political campaigns should be strictly limited.
statements.agree: Private donations to political campaigns should be strictly limited.
statements.disagree: People should be free to give as much as they like to political campaigns.
statements.note: About caps on how much individuals and companies can give to parties and candidates. Publishing who donated is not enough.

statements.text: Everyone able to work should be legally required to work.
statements.agree: Everyone able to work should be legally required to work.
statements.disagree: Working should be a free choice, not a legal duty.
statements.note: A legal duty to work for all, beyond making work a condition of welfare.

statements.text: Governments should apologise for their country's past wrongs.
statements.agree: Governments should apologise for their country's past wrongs.
statements.disagree: Governments should not apologise for their country's past.
statements.note: About official apologies for wars, colonialism, slavery and other historical wrongs.

statements.text: Armed resistance to a foreign military occupation is justified.
statements.agree: Armed resistance to a foreign military occupation is justified.
statements.disagree: Even under foreign military occupation, resistance should be unarmed.
statements.note: About whether fighting an occupying army with weapons is justified. Attacking civilians is a different question.

statements.text: Parents should be allowed to choose sex-assignment surgery for their intersex babies.
statements.agree: Parents should be allowed to choose sex-assignment surgery for their intersex babies.
statements.disagree: Sex-assignment surgery on intersex children should wait until they can consent.
statements.note: About surgery in infancy on children born with sex characteristics that are neither typically male nor female.

statements.text: Couples should be able to marry in a civil ceremony.
statements.agree: Couples should be able to marry in a civil ceremony.
statements.disagree: Marriage should only be performed by religious authorities.
statements.note: About whether a non-religious, state marriage exists alongside religious marriage.

statements.text: Conquest never gives a state a lawful claim to territory.
statements.agree: Conquest never gives a state a lawful claim to territory.
statements.disagree: A state can gain a lawful claim to territory it conquers.
statements.note: About whether land taken in war can ever become lawfully the conqueror's.

statements.text: Torture should always be illegal.
statements.agree: Torture should always be illegal.
statements.disagree: Torture should be allowed in some circumstances.
statements.note: About whether the law should forbid torture without exception, including to extract information in an emergency.

statements.text: It should be illegal for parents to spank their children.
statements.agree: It should be illegal for parents to spank their children.
statements.disagree: Parents should be allowed to spank their children.
statements.note: About physical punishment, such as smacking or spanking, as a way for parents to discipline children.

statements.text: Denying a historical genocide should be a criminal offence.
statements.agree: Denying a historical genocide should be a criminal offence.
statements.disagree: Denying a historical genocide should not be a crime.
statements.note: About laws that punish publicly denying a genocide, such as the Holocaust.

statements.text: Migrants caught crossing the border illegally should be turned back at once.
statements.agree: Migrants caught crossing the border illegally should be turned back at once.
statements.disagree: Migrants caught crossing the border illegally should be allowed to stay while their claims are heard.
statements.note: About sending people who cross a border without permission straight back, including boats at sea, without first hearing an asylum claim.

statements.text: Governments should collect statistics on their citizens' ethnicity.
statements.agree: Governments should collect statistics on their citizens' ethnicity.
statements.disagree: Governments should not record their citizens' ethnicity.
statements.note: About censuses and official statistics that ask people's ethnicity or race; some countries do, others forbid it.

statements.text: Landowners should be free to build apartment buildings on residential land.
statements.agree: Landowners should be free to build apartment buildings on residential land.
statements.disagree: Local rules should be able to limit apartment buildings on residential land.
statements.note: About zoning that reserves residential land for single-family houses.

statements.text: Social change should respect established institutions.
statements.agree: Social change should respect established institutions.
statements.disagree: Social change need not respect established institutions.
statements.note: About respect for existing institutions, independently of the pace of change.

statements.text: The state should guarantee everyone a decent standard of living.
statements.agree: Whatever their circumstances, everyone should be able to count on the state for enough to live decently, through benefits, pensions or public services.
statements.disagree: The state should not guarantee everyone a decent standard of living.
statements.note: About how far the state should provide for people, not about how welfare is designed or who pays for it. Disagreement includes wanting only a minimal safety net for the very poorest, or none.

statements.text: A former imperial power should treat the lands it once ruled as it treats any other country.
statements.agree: A former empire should claim no special ties, leadership or sphere of influence in its old territories.
statements.disagree: A former imperial power should not treat the lands it once ruled as it treats any other country.
statements.note: Disagreeing covers any special role: a cultural community such as the Commonwealth or Hispanidad, a sphere of influence, or restoring the empire itself.
